ensures: res == (this.len() == other.len() && forall |i: int| 0 <= i && i < this.len() as int ==> <&'a T>::exec_eq(this.get(i as usize).unwrap(), other.get(i as usize).unwrap()))
rationale: States the elementwise executable equality that the implementation performs (length equality plus per-index ExecSpecEq), which is the strongest natural postcondition expressible with existing vstd traits and implies the trait-level deep_view equality via the element ExecSpecEq contracts.
risks: Relies on <&'a T>::exec_eq contract to connect elementwise exec_eq to deep_view equality; if that contract is absent or weakened the link to the trait-level guarantee must be checked.
Uses unwrap() on get(); sound because length equality is required in the postcondition, but care must be taken if future changes alter the ordering of conjuncts or semantics.
